policy: A blocker may be closed only by fresh evidence satisfying the stated resolution gate. Installation, inferred readiness, dependency overrides, fallback adapters, and empty-session observations do not close a blocker.

blockers.resolution_gate: Registered isolated benchmark workspace, reachable graph, live lifecycle events normalized into the ledger, and no session leakage.
blockers.safe_next_action: Use the ORCA workspace-registration flow only after explicit operator approval; then rerun read-only probes before any workflow test.

blocking_conditions: native event stream/subscription is not exposed
full worker session semantic parity remains unverified
blockers.resolution_gate: Approved isolated session test proves spawn, polling lifecycle transitions, ledger bridge, cleanup, and zero cross-run state leakage; any native-event limitation is recorded as a protocol decision.
blockers.safe_next_action: Keep polling bridge bounded and redacted; do not use the adapter in the pilot until the remaining lifecycle semantics and protocol treatment are reviewed.

blocking_conditions: live lifecycle ledger bridge not verified
blockers.resolution_gate: Declare a stable CLI path, resolve workspace/config, authenticate at least one allowed provider in an isolated profile, bind a session, and prove lifecycle plus ledger emission.
blockers.safe_next_action: Do not install or authenticate automatically; use the official installation/provider procedures and rerun read-only status/provider probes after operator setup.

blocking_conditions: normal dependency resolution failed for all tested versions
blockers.resolution_gate: Clean pinned environment resolves the declared SDK/tool/workspace graph without --no-deps or dependency overrides, then passes workspace, permissions, and ledger probes.
blockers.safe_next_action: Wait for or identify an upstream-compatible dependency set; do not weaken the resolver policy.

blocking_conditions: full task semantic parity not verified
blockers.resolution_gate: Declared model/provider snapshot succeeds in the isolated container with network and permissions recorded, then task lifecycle and ledger parity pass.
blockers.safe_next_action: Prepare a non-production credential boundary and model manifest; do not call a provider during preflight.

blocking_conditions: external component repositories pass offline checks but are not connected to the benchmark ledger
provider-free observer bridge is insufficient for task parity
blockers.resolution_gate: Public source is isolated and version-pinned, all declared ON component actions are mapped to ledger-compatible events in a controlled task, and the matched OFF control remains unchanged.
blockers.safe_next_action: Implement the benchmark-side component action mapping and test it with deterministic fixtures before any model-backed session.
